leaveDescription: You'll lose your place. To come back you'd need a new number.
missedDescription: You've moved back {places} places and you're still in the queue.
missedWarning: One more missed turn closes your ticket.
tooLateTitle: Your time to confirm ran out
tooLateDescription: Your place has been updated below.
invalidOfficeTitle: This code isn't for an office.
invalidOfficeDescription: Ask at reception for the Mola QR code, then scan it again.
internalError: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
cannotCome: I can't come. Leave the queue
confirmHint: Tap Confirm before the time runs out, or you'll move back {places} places.
joinTitle: Take a number and leave the line.
joinDescription: Your place shows here and updates by itself. Your phone buzzes when it's your turn.
showNumber: Show this number at the desk.
doneDescription: This ticket is finished. Thanks for waiting.
leftDescription: Your place has gone to the next person.
closedDescription: You missed your turn too many times.
stillHere: Still here? Get a new number and you'll join the end of the queue.
keepOpen: Keep this page open. Your phone buzzes when it's your turn.
noNotes: The office hasn't added notes yet.
answerBy: Answered by Amazon Nova. Check anything important at the desk.
answerNotFound: The notes don't cover that. Ask at the desk when you're called.
askLimit: You've used all your questions for this ticket. Ask at the desk.
assistUnavailable: The assistant isn't available right now. Ask at the desk.
askHint: Don't type your ID number or other personal details.
